evidence.why: Allowlist scope grants access to the entire home directory, a broad scope similar to the $HOME/** case the rubric flags as vulnerable.
The handler confines paths to the entire user home directory as an allowed root, effectively granting filesystem read access across the whole home tree rather than a fixed, narrow base directory.

other_classes_observed: symlink not resolved before trust decision (TOCTOU/symlink traversal could escape canonicalized root check)
